Patients with lung cancer who undergo surgery have a recurrence rate of 30 to 50%, indicating a potential need for better tumor detection modalities.
JAS239 had favorable pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics for imaging metastatic lung lesions in mice.

digest: This study finds that the direction of effect captured by transcriptome-wide association studies is often reversed relative to the true biological mechanism, suggesting that caution is needed when interpreting these studies and using the results for downstream applications.

digest: Endometrial ablation is an established and effective treatment for women with heavy menstrual bleeding, but many patients require further treatment, with approximately 10% ultimately undergoing a hysterectomy within 2 years.

The aim of the study was to assess whether LNG-IUS insertion immediately after endometrial ablation in women with heavy menstrual bleeding reduced the need for subsequent hysterectomy within 2 years compared with endometrial ablation alone.

evidence.quote: This study was registered on the International Clinical Trials Registry Platform (NL-OMON54839) and is complete.
